generated_by: a full end-to-end run against the API on qwen3:8b during Phase C, task C6
question: Should RAQIB pilot in a Dubai hypermarket or a Greenlam plant first?

counterfactual.verdict: 2 separate pieces of evidence would each flip this on their own (e2, e1). The decision is not robust.

finding_1_unanimous_dissent.observed: The scores gave hypermarket 55 to plant 51, so the memo recommended the hypermarket. Then all FIVE seats, asked individually, said they disagreed and preferred the plant.
finding_1_unanimous_dissent.diagnosis: A 4-point margin across 5 seats and 3 axes is inside the noise. The prose round said what the 1-5 integer scoring was too coarse to express.
finding_1_unanimous_dissent.why_it_matters: A recommendation nobody in the room supports would have been presented as the room decision, with a ranking table under it that looked authoritative.
finding_1_unanimous_dissent.fix: Memo.unanimous_dissent is set when every seat dissents, and the memo carries a blockquote above the ranking telling the reader to treat it as too close to call and read the dissent log as the substance.

finding_2_the_memo_could_not_cite_what_i.observed: First run: 0 cited claims, 5 uncited, with a document sitting in the corpus. Every claim was about the PROCESS — the hypermarket option received a higher score of 55 — and nothing about a score can ground in a board paper.
finding_2_the_memo_could_not_cite_what_i.diagnosis: build_memo passed the model the transcript and the ranking, and never the corpus.
finding_2_the_memo_could_not_cite_what_i.fix: Retrieved passages are now put in front of the model, fenced as untrusted content, with an instruction to write about the substance rather than the scoring.
finding_2_the_memo_could_not_cite_what_i.result: Second run on the same session: 5 cited, 1 uncited.

finding_3_the_tradeoff_this_creates.observed: Of the 5 now-cited claims, two were sentences lifted whole from the document with nothing to do with the decision, and one was a duplicate.
finding_3_the_tradeoff_this_creates.diagnosis: A verbatim-overlap citation gate rewards copying. Asking for claims phrased close to the source so they can be checked is asking for quotation.
finding_3_the_tradeoff_this_creates.position_taken: Duplicates are removed because they are pure noise. Relevance is left to the reader: a mechanical relevance filter would put one more model judgement between the reader and the source, which is what the citation gate exists to avoid. A memo of relevant sentences that cannot be checked misleads silently; a memo of checkable sentences some of which are beside the point wastes a reader time visibly.
